task: Phase 4 — Reliability, educational accuracy, retrieval quality, latency and final QA

bugsFoundAndFixed.bug: Deterministic math check called with swapped arguments (attempt passed as the problem and the problem text missing the lesson title) → assessments were lost or left to the unreliable model judge
bugsFoundAndFixed.fix: verifyAnswer(title + narration, studentMessage) in both the extraction fallback and the cross-check
bugsFoundAndFixed.evidence: real coach pair: correct alternative (س-2)(س-3) → correct:true; wrong (س-1)(س-6) → correct:false with the deterministic reason

bugsFoundAndFixed.bug: Two regeneration nudges (thin lesson, missing assessment) forced a second full LLM call on short lessons and evaluations, doubling latency (~5.2s LLM instead of ~2.5s)
bugsFoundAndFixed.fix: removed both; the bounded extraction fallback supplies evidence instead of regenerating the lesson
bugsFoundAndFixed.evidence: stage logs showed llm-attempt0 + llm-attempt1 pairs; after the change a simple lesson completes in 3.8s end-to-end (was 8.1s in the battery for a similar short lesson)

bugsFoundAndFixed.bug: Single-word and vernacular queries returned nothing (strict score threshold + no tolerant matching)
bugsFoundAndFixed.fix: lower threshold for one-term queries + bounded fuzzy expansion (4-char prefix or one edit, weight 0.35–0.45, capped at 6)
bugsFoundAndFixed.evidence: «المتطابقات» returned [] before, 4 candidates after; the live single-word question «حل» now returns a real 5-segment lesson (was 422 no_context)

bugsFoundAndFixed.bug: The retrieval evaluation labels themselves were wrong (keys absent from the book) → meaningless metrics
bugsFoundAndFixed.fix: rebuilt the labeled dataset from verified keys with real ground-truth pages (11 queries)

bugsFoundAndFixed.bug: Arabic «equations» sent through KaTeX produced missing-glyph warnings and worse typography
bugsFoundAndFixed.fix: pure-Arabic write_latex (no backslash, ^, _ or braces) becomes write_text; real LaTeX stays mathematical
bugsFoundAndFixed.evidence: unit test + fewer warnings in dev logs (mixed Arabic/LaTeX still warns — limitation)

bugsFoundAndFixed.bug: AI phrasing variants split one skill into multiple progress rows
bugsFoundAndFixed.fix: deterministic topic canonicalization (hamza/taa folding, article stripping, light suffix stemming) applied on write + existing rows migrated/merged
bugsFoundAndFixed.evidence: DB 3 rows → 2; «تحليل كثيرات الحدود» and «تحليل كثير الحدود» merged with summed evidence

bugsFoundAndFixed.bug: Two dev-server crashes under long multi-tab test sessions
bugsFoundAndFixed.fix: none needed — confirmed dev-only hot-reload/Turbopack instability under heavy watch+session load; production builds and next start stayed stable in all phases; error boundary + credit refunds verified
bugsFoundAndFixed.evidence: crash logs showed ECONNREFUSED with no app exception; restart recovered each time

educationalCorrectness.verifyAnswer: arithmetic, fractions/decimals (tolerance 5e-5), powers, roots (±√), equivalent solution orderings, factorable quadratics, linear equations; unknown is never graded
educationalCorrectness.fairGrading: mistakes may still surface for review even when unverifiable; mastery is never recorded without verification (unknown + correct → no progress)
educationalCorrectness.beforeAfter: before: the model judge marked (س-1)(س-6) correct in a real run; after: deterministic incorrect with a coefficient reason

retrieval.dataset: qa: 11 labeled queries with ground truth derived from the book's own text
retrieval.knownMiss: «زاوية الارتفاع» (page 108) ranks below top-3 despite fuzzy matching

latency.simpleLessonEndToEnd: 3.8s (after removing the regeneration nudges; 8.1s before for a comparable short lesson)
latency.streaming: not implemented — blocker unchanged: whole-lesson validation (cross-segment source ids, board progression, repair loop); measured path documented in Phase 2

tts.sttRoundTrip: «اكس أس 4 ناقص ثلاثة اكس تربيع زائد اثنين يساوي صفر … جذر 2 وناقص جذر 2» — no LaTeX commands
tts.honestNote: verified via transcription and audio properties, not by human listening

progress.sameDayRule: a second correct answer on the same day stays DEVELOPING; a later day reaches DEMONSTRATED
progress.normalization: existing rows migrated and merged safely (counts summed, strictest state, earliest due date)

browser.simpleEquation: lesson in 3.8s, KaTeX equation + explanation on the board, no error, no overflow, credit charged

accounting.realCalls: ~12 tutor turns + 2 speech + 1 transcription this phase
accounting.credits: 1 per tutor turn; refunds verified on failures; balance 20 → 3 on the QA fixture
accounting.budget: daily cap setting preserved (in-memory locally, resets on dev restart — noted)

remaining: Model judge alone still unreliable for non-deterministic math forms; deterministic coverage is bounded to the implemented patterns
Mixed Arabic+LaTeX still triggers KaTeX glyph warnings
Only mathematics has a real book; other subjects remain dev fixtures
verdict: GO for platform/content preparation with the documented limitations; no production-blocking defect found
